actualCoverage.readMethod: Read all 126 sourceText and Japanese blocks, title and three notes. Full displays covered 0-24,25-49,50-89,90-114,115-125 without omitted poetry. Checked individual poem lines and dialogue transitions. Hashes only record provenance.

changes.reason: In this imperial encomium 赤子 denotes the people under the sovereign, not just infants.

changes.before: 紅を添えた湘裙には、落梅の舞が舞われる。
changes.after: 紅を添えた湘裙は、落梅の曲に舞う。
changes.reason: Restore the dancing red skirt image; remove an unnatural passive construction that made the dance occur on the skirt.

changes.before: よい夢を見る昼が、ようやく長くなったのだから。
changes.after: 昼のよい夢が、ようやく長く続くのだから。
changes.reason: 長 refers to the pleasant daytime dream, not to seasonal lengthening of daylight.
三春 covers the three months of spring, not the calendar month March.

changes.before: 何を耕し織るのに、忙しくすることがあろう。
changes.after: どうして耕し織るのに、忙しくする必要があろう。
changes.reason: 何須 asks why there is any need, not what is being tilled or woven.
Use human neck ornament wording for 項圈 in a gift list rather than animal-collar wording; retain count and metals.
